name: DokiDoki Pretty League
source:
The Japanese women professional baseball league (known as JPL) announces the start of the season. Juniro is a coach of Pink Angels team and their first game is against Blue Dolphins. On the way to the stadium a wild cat jumps before the bus causing the bus to fall down the chasm. Will they get out in time for the game?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-december-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
日本女子职业棒球联盟（简称JPL）宣布赛季开始。朱尼罗是粉红天使队的教练，他们的第一场比赛是对阵蓝海豚队。在去体育场的路上，一只野猫在公交车前跳来跳去，导致公交车掉进深渊。他们能及时出去参加比赛吗？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-december-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
